mission: Turn the current MESA-QA snapshot into a detachable, evidence-driven resident QA engineer that tests MESA through the real Codex/MCP lifecycle and only performs bounded candidate-only repair after a genuine reproducible bug is proven.

S001.title: Verify official MESA 0/1/2 validation contract
S001.required_result: Determine from MESA source/config whether official validation modes 0, 1 and 2 exist and identify their exact public configuration contract.
S001.fail_rule: If the official contract does not exist, set BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Do not implement a shadow validator inside MESA-QA.

S002.title: Wire MESA-QA to official MESA validation mode
S002.required_result: MESA-QA selects the official MESA validation mode without implementing validation policy itself.

S003.title: Add mesa.candidate_ref exact pinning
S003.required_result: Resolve branch, tag or SHA read-only and create candidate from the exact resolved commit without switching the original checkout.

S004.title: Remove hard-coded candidate SHA assumptions
S004.required_result: All live assertions derive expected candidate identity from config and runtime evidence.

S005.title: Strict Tester action and scenario identity validation
S005.required_result: Returned action_id and scenario_event_id must exactly match the expected action.

S006.title: Independently prove real MCP invocation
S006.required_result: Expected MCP tool equals independently observed real MCP invocation. Tester self-report is non-authoritative.

S007.title: Fix deterministic recall correctness matcher
S007.required_result: Structured MESA result first, deterministic fallback second, ambiguous or negated result becomes NEEDS_REVIEW instead of PASS.
tests_required: FastAPI vs 'does not use FastAPI' must not PASS

S008.title: Make thread rotation a hard evidence gate
S008.required_result: Rotation is PASS only after old thread exists, new thread exists, IDs differ and fresh-thread recall succeeds through verified MESA MCP.

S009.title: Allow confirmed bug continuation when repair is disabled
S009.required_result: CONFIRMED_BUG to RUNNING is valid when repair is disabled or gated.

S010.title: Make critical state persistence awaited
S010.required_result: WAITING_FOR_CODEX, PAUSED, STOPPING, COMPLETED and FAILED cannot rely on fire-and-forget persistence.

S011.title: Correct persisted immutable and candidate metadata
S011.required_result: started_at is immutable and candidate path, base SHA and current HEAD are stored in distinct correct fields.

S012.title: Guarantee unique run IDs
S012.required_result: Run ID includes actual date and random/UUID suffix and collisions fail closed at filesystem/control-state boundaries.

S013.title: Add run-scoped control commands
S013.required_result: pause, resume and stop support explicit --run-id and do not rely on newest-directory heuristics.

S014.title: Poll control DB while paused
S014.required_result: Paused controller observes resume and stop requests and consumes/acknowledges control requests.

S015.title: Implement active-action emergency cancellation
S015.required_result: Stop can cancel active Tester Codex, Repair Codex and approval polling and safely persist evidence.

S016.title: Implement crash resume
S016.required_result: Persisted cursor, epoch, seed, action counter, thread metadata and candidate identity are restored and validated before continuation.

S017.title: Add top-level exception cleanup
S017.required_result: Unexpected initialization/runtime exceptions persist FAILED, terminate owned child processes and verify original MESA integrity.

S018.title: Implement background process-tree resource hard-stop
S018.required_result: resources.sample_seconds is honored and process-tree hard limits trigger STOPPING and active-action cancellation.

S019.title: Add epoch-specific runtime event identity
S019.required_result: Template event ID and runtime event ID are distinct and repeated epochs do not silently reuse Oracle event identity.

S020.title: Fix forget to re-remember semantics
S020.required_result: Current re-remembered value is not considered forgotten merely because a historical forget exists.

S021.title: Fix historical query semantics
S021.required_result: Historical expected values do not accidentally include the current corrected value.

S022.title: Add missing behavioral scenarios
S022.required_result: Scenario coverage includes duplicate, semantic_duplicate, idempotency, conflict, multi_fact and forget/re-remember.

S023.title: Make reproduction idempotency strategy explicit
S023.required_result: Each reproduction specifies fresh_attempt or reuse_same_key according to the tested semantic.

S024.title: Remove or wire dead configuration
S024.required_result: Every shipped config field has production behavior or is removed.

S025.title: Normalize standard behavioral cadence
S025.required_result: Standard profile uses a reasonable behavioral cadence rather than acting as an accidental load tester.

S026.title: Implement standalone production reproduction phase
S026.required_result: Confirmed anomaly produces a real reproduction bundle rather than only replaying the same Tester event.

S027.title: Require genuine source-path PRE-FIX FAIL
S027.required_result: Controller executes a regression that reaches the real source/runtime path and demonstrably fails before repair.
forbidden: captured expected equals captured actual pseudo-test

S028.title: Capture pre-repair candidate snapshot
S028.required_result: Capture candidate HEAD, status, tracked diff, untracked set and original MESA baseline immediately before repair.

S029.title: Add pre and post Repair Codex candidate identity hard gate
S029.required_result: Validate top-level, git common-dir, branch prefix, containment, lineage and original MESA baseline before and after Repair Codex.

S030.title: Make Repairer structured success authoritative gate
S030.required_result: Repairer success=false blocks commit and cannot be overwritten by later controller logic.

S031.title: Enforce post-repair bounded diff
S031.required_result: Post-repair validation counts files and changed lines, checks forbidden paths and includes untracked files.

S032.title: Require regression and targeted tests
S032.required_result: The genuine regression and relevant targeted tests must both pass before commit.

S033.title: Commit approved paths only
S033.required_result: Only paths approved by post-repair confinement validation are staged and committed.

S034.title: Restart candidate after repair
S034.required_result: Candidate runtime is restarted from the repaired commit using the same required isolated QA storage.

S035.title: Run identical live MCP reproduction after restart
S035.required_result: The same semantic live MCP reproduction passes after restart.

S036.title: Move VERIFIED strictly after live MCP PASS
S036.required_result: VERIFIED cannot be persisted before successful identical live reproduction.

S037.title: Fail repair safely without false VERIFIED
S037.required_result: Any failed repair becomes REPAIR_FAILED or NEEDS_REVIEW and is never VERIFIED.

S038.title: Implement safe teardown
S038.required_result: Teardown validates run identity, containment, Git identity and symlink safety before stopping owned processes and removing candidate resources.

S039.title: Implement real run status command
S039.required_result: Status reports persisted run state, candidate identity, PIDs, active action, last action and blocker.

S040.title: Complete doctor contract
S040.required_result: Doctor validates required CLIs, candidate ref, storage isolation, auth type, paid-provider fallback state and MESA validation mode support.

S041.title: Generate evidence-derived final report
S041.required_result: Final report derives every PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT_RUN claim from evidence and persisted state.

S042.title: Keep autonomous repair disabled in shipped profiles
S042.required_result: Lite, default and standard profiles do not silently enable autonomous repair before certification.

S043.title: Remove or implement dead stress-behavioral profile
S043.required_result: CLI cannot silently accept a non-existent profile and fall back to default.

S044.title: Use per-run ephemeral QA credentials
S044.required_result: Predictable static QA secrets are replaced with per-run ephemeral values where compatible with the runtime contract.

S045.title: Fix subprocess log handle lifecycle
S045.required_result: Parent-side log handles do not leak across repeated runtime and gateway restarts.

S046.title: Run 5 to 10 minute engineering smoke
S046.required_result: Real MESA venv, real Codex and real MCP smoke with repair OFF.

S047.title: Run 15 to 30 minute lite acceptance
S047.required_result: Repair-OFF endurance includes remember, approval, COMMITTED, recall, paraphrase, correction, forget, thread rotation, restart, pause/resume, stop and integrity verification.

S048.title: Run one controlled candidate-only repair E2E
S048.required_result: A controlled defect proves anomaly, reproduction, PRE-FIX FAIL, bounded repair, tests, restart, identical live MCP repro and final VERIFIED ordering.

S049.title: Run controller kill and resume acceptance
S049.required_result: Force controller termination and verify correct persisted recovery without corrupting candidate, Oracle or run state.

S050.title: Run third independent audit
S050.required_result: Independent audit evaluates A01 through A44 and returns GO before certification changes.

A11.title: Remember to approval to COMMITTED PASS

A23.title: Emergency stop during active action PASS

A26.title: Confirmed bug with repair OFF continues run

history.details: Verified official MESA 0/1/2 validation contract. Sourced from MESA commit 06ebd35a5dc43b75c33351705ddf4afa0a732c61.
Wired MESA-QA to official MESA validation mode through mesa.validation_mode and candidate runtime environment propagation.
Added mesa.candidate_ref exact pinning with read-only ref resolution and verified main checkout immutability.
Derived candidate identity dynamically from ref and runtime evidence without hardcoded SHA assumptions. Phase F0 complete.
Enforced strict Tester action_id and scenario_event_id identity validation; stale/wrong/missing identities fail closed.
Independently extracted real MCP invocations from Codex event streams; rejected non-authoritative self-reports.
Implemented deterministic recall matcher with structured priority, word-boundary matching, and negation/ambiguity detection.
Enforced hard evidence gate for thread rotation (old/new thread distinctness, recall pass, MCP verification). Phase F1 complete.
Allowed confirmed bug continuation when repair is disabled (CONFIRMED_BUG -> RUNNING).
Made all state machine transitions and critical state persistence explicitly awaited via _set_state.
Persisted immutable started_at and correctly stored candidate_base_sha, branch, head, and worktree in distinct columns.
Guaranteed unique run IDs with timestamps and random UUID suffixes, and enforced fail-closed collision checks.
Supported explicit --run-id targeting for CLI control commands (pause, resume, stop).
Continuously polled and consumed/cleared control requests (resume/stop) while paused.
Implemented active action tracking, emergency cancellation, and process group termination.
Implemented crash resume restoring state, cursor, seed, and candidate invariants from DB.
Added top-level exception cleanup persisting FAILED state, stopping all child processes, and verifying MESA integrity.
Implemented recursive process-tree resource sampling and background hard-stop emergency cancellation. Phase F2 complete.
Added epoch-specific runtime event identity (ep{epoch}_{template_id}) preventing silent multi-epoch event collisions.
Fixed forget to re-remember semantics and preserved decimal/IP dot boundaries in sentence evaluation.
Fixed historical query semantics to return only status='HISTORICAL' facts and exclude current corrected values.
Added missing behavioral scenarios covering duplicate, semantic_duplicate, idempotency, conflict, multi-fact, and re-remember.
Made reproduction idempotency strategy explicit (fresh_attempt vs reuse_same_key) during recheck.
Removed dead config fields and wired codex model/json parameters and full suite verification.
Normalized standard profile behavioral cadence from 2s-10s to 30s-90s. Phase F3 complete.
Implemented standalone production reproduction bundle containing bug.json, user_sequence.jsonl, manifest.json, and reproduce scripts.
Enforced genuine source-path PRE-FIX FAIL verification rejecting pseudo-tests and unexpected pre-fix passes.
Captured pre-repair candidate snapshot (HEAD, branch, status, tracked diff, untracked set) and asserted main repo immutability.
Enforced pre/post repair candidate identity hard gate validating containment, common-dir, branch prefix, lineage, and baseline integrity.
Made RepairResult.success authoritative gate blocking commit and preventing overwrite on failure.
Enforced post-repair bounded diff validating changed file count, tracked/untracked line changes, and forbidden paths.
Enforced post-repair regression and targeted test suite passes prior to repair commit.
Ensured repair commit stages and commits strictly approved confinement paths with index reset.
Verified candidate service restart from repaired worktree with validated safe paths and isolated QA storage.
Executed identical live MCP reproduction after restart, recorded verdict and updated repair result.
Persisted VERIFIED status strictly upon successful live MCP reproduction and prevented false positive status.
Fails repair safely on unexpected exception or gate/test failure without marking bug as VERIFIED. Phase F4 complete.
Implemented safe teardown validating run identity, containment, git identity, symlink safety, and protected branch preservation.
Implemented real run status command with candidate identity, process PIDs, active action progress, last action, blockers, and JSON support.
Completed doctor contract validating required CLIs, candidate ref, storage isolation, auth type, paid-provider fallback, and MESA validation modes.
Generated evidence-derived final report in json and markdown deriving verdicts and metrics directly from persisted run state.
Enforced repair.enabled: false across all shipped profiles (default, lite, standard) prior to certification.
Implemented stress-behavioral profile configuration and prevented silent configuration profile fallback.
Used per-run ephemeral QA credentials (api_key, encryption_key, principal_id) in ProcessManager.
Fixed parent-side log handle lifecycle in MesaCandidateRuntime and MesaMCPGatewayProcess preventing descriptor leaks.
Executed 5-minute engineering smoke test with real MESA venv, real Codex in read-only sandbox, and real MCP gateway.
Executed 15-minute lite acceptance endurance run exercising full scenario and control lifecycle with repair OFF.
Executed controlled candidate-only repair E2E proving anomaly, reproduction, PRE-FIX FAIL, bounded diff, tests, restart, and VERIFIED.
Verified controller kill and crash-resume acceptance restoring state, invariants, cursor and Oracle without corruption.
Executed Third Independent Audit evaluating all 44 acceptance criteria (A01-A44), issuing GO certification verdict.
